tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ma hā shrī sū tra/ bod skad du/ dpal chen mo'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das bde ba can na bzhugs so// de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug /bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der song ste phyan nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug go /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal chen mo la gzigs nas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzags dbang phyug la 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to// dge slong ngam/ dge slong ma 'am/ dge bsnyen nam/ dge bsnyen ma gang yang rung bas dpal chen mo'i ming bcu gnyis po shes pa dang*/ 'chang ba dang*/ klog pa dang*/ 'bri ba dang*/ 'drir 'jug pa de ni dbul ba bor te phyug por 'gyur ro// de nas 'khor 'dus pa thams cad kyis de ltar gyur cig ces kun nas gsol to// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis dpal chen mo'i mtshan bcu gnyis po bka' stsal pa/ dpal ldan ma/ dpal dkris ma/ padma'i 'phreng ba can/ nor gyi bdag mo/ dkar mo/ grags pa chen mo/ padma'i spyan/ byed pa mo/ 'od chen mo/ zas sbyin ma/ rin po che rab sbyin mo/ dpal chen mo// syad ya the da na/ dzi ni gri ni/ sarba artha sa dha ni/ sha shi na a la ga shi ma na/ nā sha ya/ siddan tu mant+ra pa dai swā hā// oṃ bi gu ni ba ra ma su bha ge swā hā/ gang la la zhig dus gsum du 'don par byed na mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rgyal bar 'gyur ro// skal pa bzang po dang ldan par 'gyur ro// 'byor pa zad mi shes pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro// de la thams cad kyis bu lta bu'i 'du shes bskyed de dga' bar 'gyur zhing ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin byed par 'gyur ro// rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad par bklags na// tshangs pas drag shul gyi las byas kyang mi tshugs la/

sangs rgyas mang po la bsnyen bkur byas par 'gyur ro// bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// dpal chen mo'i mdo rdzogs so/// /sangs rgyas phal po che la phyag 'tshal lo// na mo buddha ya/ oṃ na mo buddha ya/ oṃ dhu na dhu na/ oṃ dhu na dhu na ma hā bā ri ye swā hā// / phal chen gsung bsgrags pa dang mnyam par 'gyur ro/// /
